page.overview:
What is Eighteen Hells?

The are halls in the Underworld where sinners are punished.

The Eighteen Hells are a set of halls and chambers located past the Mountain of Perpetual Shade. There are eighteen halls, which souls are sentenced time in depending on sins they committed in life:
